miner.name: Miner
miner.subtitle: Underground Mining Operations
description: Extract valuable ores from underground deposits
Use mining equipment to break rocks
Transport materials to processing facility
Work as a team for bonus rewards

step1Desc: Walk up to the NPC at the quarry
Press E to open the job menu
Select your area and press Start
step2Desc: Head to the portable cabin nearby
Step inside to change into your work outfit
Your original clothes are restored when the job ends
step3Desc: Go to the job vehicle's open trunk
Pick up a pickaxe — each player takes their own
Up to 4 tools available for coop play
step4Desc: Walk to the mining area with your pickaxe
Aim at a rock and swing to break it
Rocks shatter into collectable ore pieces
step5Desc: Pick up the ore pieces after breaking a rock
You carry the ore in your arms
Bring it back to the vehicle trunk
step6Desc: Carry your ore to the vehicle trunk
The ore is automatically loaded into the truck
Fill the trunk then drive to the processing area
step7Desc: Drive to the processing point
Place your ore on the weighing scale
Each item is weighed and you receive payment
step8Desc: After processing, a carrier NPC collects the items
The NPC walks over and picks up the processed ore
You earn money and XP for each completed batch

Bring it back to the vehicle trunk
step6Desc: Carry your log to the vehicle trunk

Fill the trunk then drive to the processing area
step7Desc: Drive to the processing point
Place your logs on the weighing scale
Each item is weighed and you receive payment
step8Desc: After processing, a carrier NPC collects the items
The NPC walks over and picks up the processed logs
You earn money and XP for each completed batch

step6Desc: Carry your full crate to the truck

cleaner.name: Street Cleaner
cleaner.subtitle: City Cleaning Service
description: Take the mop from the vehicle trunk
Go to dirt spots marked on the map
Clean the stains using your mop
Return to get paid when finished

step1Desc: Walk up to the NPC at the cleaning depot
Press E to open the job menu
Select your route and press Start
step2Desc: Head to the portable cabin nearby
Step inside to change into your work outfit
Your original clothes are restored when the job ends
step3Desc: Go to the job vehicle's trunk
Pick up a mop — each player takes their own
Up to 4 tools available for coop play
step4Desc: Get in the vehicle and follow the GPS
Drive to the marked stain locations
Each route has multiple dirt spots to clean
step5Desc: Walk up to a dirt stain with your mop
Click the targets that appear to scrub the stain
Each stain requires multiple hits to fully clean
step6Desc: After cleaning all stains, return to the depot
Speak to the NPC to collect your payment
Earn bonus money for completing the full route

step5Desc: Aim the pressure wand at the dirty surface
Hold left mouse button to spray water
Keep spraying until the stain is fully cleaned
step6Desc: After cleaning all stains, return to the depot
Step into the marker to collect your payment
Earn bonus money for completing the full route

description: Take the pressure wand from the vehicle

step1Desc: Walk up to the NPC at the detailing depot
Press E to open the job menu
Accept the job to begin
step2Desc: Head to the portable cabin nearby
Step inside to change into your work outfit
Your original clothes are restored when the job ends
step3Desc: Go to the job vehicle
Pick up the pressure wand from the back

step4Desc: Get in the vehicle and follow the GPS
Drive to the marked customer car locations
Park close — the hose has limited range
step5Desc: Aim the pressure wand at the dirty spots
Hold left mouse button to spray water
The car gets cleaner as you wash each spot
step6Desc: After detailing all cars, return to the depot
Return your tools and finish the job

Select your area and press Start
step2Desc: Head to the changing area near the pet shop
Step inside to change into your work outfit

step3Desc: Drive to the client's home in Vinewood Hills

step4Desc: Walk with your dog on a leash
Cover the required distance shown on your HUD

step5Desc: Walk the dog back to the client's home

step5Desc: Carry packages to the van's open rear doors

step6Desc: Drive to the marked delivery location
Take a box from the trunk and carry it

step7Desc: After all deliveries, drive back to the depot

step2Desc: Walk to the dock and board your boat

step3Desc: Stop the boat at the dive zone marker
Press E to drop the anchor
Jump into the water and dive down
step4Desc: Find coral and trash on the seabed
Press E to collect coral for selling
Clean up trash for bonus XP
step5Desc: Return the boat to the dock
Walk to the buyer NPC nearby
Press E to sell your collected corals

treasurehunter.name: Treasure Hunter
treasurehunter.subtitle: Underwater Treasure Hunting

step1Desc: Head to the dock and talk to the instructor

step2Desc: Walk to the dock and board your boat
